The Program emits 1-TM-score constraints; raw TM-score needed by paper endpoints is recovered as 1 minus the stored score.
Implementation seeds 0 through 4 reproduce the paper's seed count but are not claimed to be the paper's undisclosed seed values.
Adenylate kinase 4AKE/1AKE is a buildable diagnostic pair, not one of the paper's reported aggregate targets.
Every full-Proto versus fused-Proto comparison uses the same seed-specific Program variant in both arms.
